Raise gmid1/L1 for noise, tail headroom and gm. Longer tail L. Recalibrate the UGBW model to 0.83·gm1/Cc and the noise model to an input-plus-mirror split."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (24.0, 16.0, 25.0),      # input pair gm/Id (high -> lower Vgs -> more tail Vds, more gm)
    "L1":    (2.2, 0.8, 3.0),         # input pair L (flicker area)
    "Itail": (12.0e-6, 9e-6, 13e-6),  # first-stage tail current
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),       # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Lp":    (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),         # PMOS mirror L (flicker area)
    "L7":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),         # output PMOS L (gm/Id set by Vgs matching)
    "Iout":  (15.2e-6, 13e-6, 17e-6), # output stage current
    "Cc":    (0.42e-12, 0.28e-12, 0.7e-12),
    "gmidb": (16.0, 10.0, 20.0),      # NMOS mirrors gm/Id
    "Lb":    (3.0, 1.0, 3.0),         # NMOS mirror L (tail impedance -> CMRR)
    "gmidc": (20.0, 12.0, 24.0),      # NMOS cascode gm/Id
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)

    Itail = p["Itail"]
    Iout = p["Iout"]
    imax = 37.2e-6 - iref
    if Itail + Iout > imax:
        Iout = max(imax - Itail, 10e-6)
    Ih = Itail / 2
    Cc = p["Cc"]
    Lc = 0.5

    # ---- input pair with body effect ----
    vtail = 0.2
    for _ in range(4):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Ih, vds=0.22, vsb=vtail)
        vtail = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.17)
    vd1 = vtail + 0.22
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Ih, vds=vd1 - vtail, vsb=vtail)

    # ---- PMOS mirror ----
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ih, vds=1.1)
    for _ in range(3):
        m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ih, vds=m3.vgs)
    m4 = m3
    vdd1 = vdd - m3.vgs

    # ---- NMOS cascodes ----
    mc = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], Lc, Ih, vds=max(vdd1 - vd1, 0.12), vsb=vd1)
    vcasn = vd1 + mc.vgs

    # ---- output PMOS: choose gm/Id so Vgs7 == Vgs3 (Vx == Vd1, symmetric first stage) ----
    lo, hi = 4.0, 22.0
    m7 = lut.size("p", 0.5 * (lo + hi), p["L7"], Iout, vds=0.9)
    for _ in range(18):
        g = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        m7 = lut.size("p", g, p["L7"], Iout, vds=0.9)
        if m7.vgs > m3.vgs:
            lo = g      # Vgs too large -> raise gm/Id
        else:
            hi = g
    gmid7 = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    m7 = lut.size("p", gmid7, p["L7"], Iout, vds=0.9)

    # ---- NMOS bias mirrors ----
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.6)
    for _ in range(3):
        mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=mb.vgs)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], Itail, vds=vtail)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], Iout, vds=0.9)

    Rcas = max((vcasn - mb.vgs) / iref, 1e3)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.R("Rcas", "ibias", "nb", Rcas)
    n.dev("Mb", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "nb", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "a1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "a2", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M1c", "d1", "ibias", "a1", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M2c", "x", "ibias", "a2", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "nb", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.C("Cc", "vout", "a2", Cc)

    # ---- first-order predictions (calibrated against iter-4 sim) ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    rcas = (mc.gm + mc.gmbs) / (mc.gds * m1.gds + 1e-30)
    g1 = m4.gds + 1.0 / rcas
    A1 = gm1 / g1
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    A0 = A1 * A2
    ugbw = 0.83 * gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m4.cdd + mc.cdd + 5e-15
    fp2 = 1.4 * m7.gm * Cc / (C1 * (cl + Cc)) / (2 * PI)
    fcas = mc.gm / (2 * PI * (mc.cgg + m1.cdd + 2e-15))
    fmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (m3.cgg + m4.cgg + m3.cdd))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fcas)) \
         - 0.3 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fmir))
    slew = 0.9 * min(Itail / Cc, Iout / (cl + Cc))
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.8 / slew + 6 * tau
    # flicker: ~70% (power) input pair, ~30% mirror at iter-4 point (L1=1.5, Ih=5.5u, Lp=1.2, gm3/gm1~0.62)
    vin2 = (0.7 * 498e-9 ** 2) * (1.5 / p["L1"]) ** 2 * (5.5e-6 / Ih) * (21.0 / p["gmid1"])
    vmir2 = (0.3 * 498e-9 ** 2) * (1.2 / p["Lp"]) ** 2 * ((m3.gm / gm1) / 0.62) ** 2 * (4.6e-6 / Ih) * (10.7 / max(p["gmidp"], 1))
    noise_1k = math.sqrt(vin2 + vmir2)
    cmrr = A1 * 2 * m3.gm / (m5.gds + 1e-30) / 8.0
    swing = vdd - (max(m7.vdsat, 0.08) + max(m8.vdsat, 0.08))
    power = vdd * (iref + Itail + Iout)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A0),
        "ugbw": ugbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "slew": slew,
        "settle": settle,
        "noise_1k": noise_1k,
        "cmrr_db": db(cmrr),
        "psrr_db": db(A0) - 4,
        "swing": swing,
        "power": power,
    }
```
